page_title: ATA 2-0 EMP | Atalanta v Empoli 28/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Close! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot narrowly over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
88' The ball is cleared after Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is behind the touchline and Empoli will take a throw-in.
85' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
85' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
84' Substitution. Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) on for Ademola Lookman.
83' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
82' Good clearance! El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. Atalanta have a corner.
82' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
80' Razvan Marin (Empoli) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Marco Carnesecchi was alert and made a comfortable save.
80' The resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is cleared.

80' A lofted cross from Ederson (Atalanta) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
78' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
77' Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
74' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Matteo Cancellieri (Empoli) replacing Youssef Maleh.
73' It will be a substitution. Teun Koopmeiners (Atalanta) is ready to enter the pitch as Aleksey Miranchuk walks off.
71' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) takes a long-range free kick and whips it into the box. The goalkeeper reads it well and leaps high to intercept the ball.
70' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for an infringement.
69' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Marco Carnesecchi easily deals with the threat.
69' Razvan Marin (Empoli) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
68' Michael Fabbri blows for a foul after Isak Hien (Atalanta) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Empoli earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
65' Youssef Maleh (Empoli) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
63' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.

63' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Elia Caprile makes a comfortable save.
62' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Jacopo Fazzini is replaced by Viktor Kovalenko (Empoli).
61' The substitution has been made. Francesco Caputo (Empoli) has replaced M'Baye Niang.
61' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alberto Grassi walks off the pitch to be replaced by Razvan Marin (Empoli).
61' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) launches a cross from the corner, but Elia Caprile is alert to thwart the effort.
61' Isak Hien (Atalanta) wins himself enough space to meet the resulting corner and fires the ball at goal, but the keeper does well to stop his effort. Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
59' Flag up against El Bilal Toure (Atalanta). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matteo Ruggeri departs the field of play to be replaced by Hans Hateboer (Atalanta).
57' Gian Piero Gasperini has decided to make a change. Sead Kolasinac (Atalanta) replaces Berat Djimsiti.
57' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marten de Roon as he is replaced by Ederson (Atalanta).
56' A rebound falls at the feet of Giuseppe Pezzella (Empoli) who unleashes a shot from long range towards the goal. However, his effort is poor and it flies high over the crossbar.
56' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
56' Liberato Cacace (Empoli) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball is out of play. Empoli win a corner kick.
54' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
51' 2 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom left corner.
49' Wonderful movement by Atalanta. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
47' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.

45+3' A pass travels right across the box to Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom left corner, but Elia Caprile denies him with a decent save.
45+2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
45+2' A cross from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Atalanta.
45+1' A pass from Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) is intercepted by Marco Carnesecchi and the move breaks down.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
44' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
43' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
42' 1 - 0 Goal! Elia Caprile gets a hand on the penalty from Mario Pasalic (Atalanta), but can't stop it from flying inside the left post.
41' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
41' It’s a PENALTY to Atalanta after the VAR review!
40' There's a break in play and referee Michael Fabbri must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Atalanta using VAR. This could be interesting!
40' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
39' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. The referee points to the corner flag and Atalanta will take a corner.
38' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
37' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
36' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
34' Aleksey Miranchuk (Atalanta) attempts to find El Bilal Toure, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.

33' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it.
32' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle after Youssef Maleh (Empoli) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
30' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
29' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Atalanta will have a corner.
27' Michael Fabbri interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).

25' Berat Djimsiti (Atalanta) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just wide of the left post from close in. The ball goes out of play and Empoli will have a goal kick.
25' Davide Nicola is forced to make a change. Sebastian Walukiewicz is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Liberato Cacace (Empoli).
24' Atalanta have a free kick from a promising distance.
24' Sebastiano Luperto (Empoli) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Michael Fabbri had an easy-decision to make.
22' Sebastian Walukiewicz (Empoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
21' The game is interrupted. Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
21' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
20' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Atalanta are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
14' Foul! El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
13' Half-chance! Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) plays a pass into the box, but Elia Caprile reacts well to snuff out the attack.
12' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
11' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Empoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
9' Jacopo Fazzini (Empoli) rises above the defence inside the box, but his header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
8' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
7' A pass lands at the feet of Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
5' Alberto Grassi (Empoli) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
5' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out El Bilal Toure (Atalanta) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
4' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
3' M'Baye Niang (Empoli) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post.
3' Emmanuel Gyasi (Empoli) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is out of play. Atalanta will have a throw-in.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Empoli will have the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri was nominated as the referee for this game.
